research_question: Does a model-compatible full-frame Canny control reduce RGB-proxy appearance leakage while preserving the same action trajectory?

rules: Within each case and seed, both arms use the same prompt, negative prompt, reference count, reference image, edit mask, VACE scale, frame count, steps and compositor.
The two arms have identical dimensions and therefore identical seeded noise shape in the frozen runtime.
Projection and pixel diagnostics use lossless raw PNG frames rather than decoding the MP4.
No output-dependent retry, seed replacement, repair or arm-specific prompt is allowed.
Full-frame Canny is a model-compatibility diagnostic derived from the same imperfect renderer; it is not a new geometric ground truth.
Two development cases and three seeds cannot establish generalization or publication-level effectiveness.

claim_limit: Representation failure-localization only. A positive result supports testing corrected geometry and control scheduling; it does not prove 3D superiority, source conservation, physical correctness or generalization.
